fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 5% of Gross Sales or $1,000/month. Technology Fee is currently 1% of Gross Sales (franchisor reserves right to increase to 2%). Worldwide Creative Marketing Fee is 1% of Gross Sales. Local Advertising is 2% of Gross Sales (paid to local vendors, not franchisor). Advertising Cooperative up to 0.5% of Gross Sales (counts toward local advertising requirement). Device Query Fee is $0.05–$3.00 per device. Promotional Programs vary, not to exceed $250/day. Training for additional/replacement employees is $7,500 for 2 trainees plus $2,000 per additional trainee. "Gross Sales" means total sales minus sales tax and customer refunds.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | The greater of 5% of Gross Sales or $1,000 per calendar month (see note 2) | Payable on the 1st day of each month for the previous calendar month's Gross Sales | "Gross Sales" are the total sales minus sales tax and customer refunds. Royalty Fees are payable by automatic debit and funds must be made available in your account for withdrawal. If the 1st day of any month is not a business day, the payment is due the next business day.
Technology Fee | Currently, 1% of Gross Sales (4) We reserve the right to increase the Technology Fee to 2% of Gross Sales. | Payable at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | For new or improved technology for the benefit of the System and the Franchised Business, including but not limited to, proprietary software, assigned phone numbers and email addresses, a franchise portal, benchmarking platform or other operations or communications systems.
Device Query Fee | $0.05 to $3.00 per device. | Payable on demand | The Device Query Fee is a fee for a service that (i) checks whether a device is lost or stolen, (ii) verifies a device's authenticity, and (iii) identifies its specifications.
Worldwide Creative Marketing Fee | 1% of Gross Sales | Payable at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | Payable to us. The Worldwide Creative Marketing fund is described in Item 11.
Local Advertising | 2% of Gross Sales (4) | Must be spent each month | Payable directly to your local advertising vendors. Any advertising that you propose to use must first be approved by us. We reserve the right to collect this amount from you with thirty (30) days prior written notification.
Advertising Cooperative | As determined by the members, but not more than 0.5% Gross Sales | Quarterly | Any amount you contribute to an advertising cooperative will count toward your local advertising requirement, but if the amount you contribute to an advertising cooperative is less than the amount you must spend for local advertising, you must still spend the difference locally.
Promotional Programs | Varies, depending on length and type of promotion. Not to exceed $250/day | As incurred | In addition to your monthly Local Advertising requirement, you must participate in the additional promotional programs that we may require.
Training Program for Additional or Replacement Employees | $7,500 for 2 trainees, and $2,000 for each additional trainee | 10 days before training begins | The training program lasts for approximately 7 days and is conducted in Massapequa, NY.
